title: Why it sucks being the referee

scenes.text: Why it sucks being the referee.
Your very first game. Under nines. A grandma calls you blind.
You give a free kick. Half the crowd hates you. You don't give it... the other half hates you.
Ninety minutes. You run ten kilometres. Nobody even passes to you.
You make a hundred decisions. Ninety-nine are right. Everyone talks about the other one.
Last minute. Penalty! Suddenly, eleven players are screaming in your face.
No VAR. No replay. Just you... and two hundred phones filming.
After the game, you walk to your car. Alone. Someone shouts: "Get home safe, ref!" You're not sure if it's nice.
That's the thing about being the referee. Without you... there is no game.
Tag a referee. Tell them: thanks for the game.
